title: Sequencing thousands of single-cell genomes with combinatorial indexing
protocol: Triturate gently to break up cell clumps in suspension cell culture.
Pellet cells by spinning at 500xg for 5 minutes.
Wash with 500 μL ice cold PBS.
Aspirate media and wash cells with 10 mL of PBS at 37°C in adherent cell culture.
Add enough 0.25% Trypsin at 37°C to cover monolayer.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes or until 90% of cells are no longer adhering to surface.
Add 37°C media at a 1:1 ratio to quench Trypsin.
Pellet cells by spinning at 500xg for 5 minutes in adherent cell culture.
Wash with 500 μL ice cold PBS.
Place tissue sample in 2 mL dounce homogenizer on ice.
Add 2 mL of NIB buffer to sample and allow to incubate on ice for 5 minutes in tissue samples.
Dounce 5 times with loose pestle followed by 15 strokes with tight pestle.
Put sample through 35 μM cell strainer.
Pellet cells or nuclei by spinning at 500xg for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in 200 μL 12.5 mM LIS in NIB buffer.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Add 800 μL NIB buffer and 5 μL DAPI (5 mg/mL).
Gently pass through 35 μM cell strainer.
Triturate gently to break up cell clumps.
Add 406 μL of 37% formaldehyde to 10 mL of cells in media and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes with gentle shaking.
Add 800 μL of 2.5 M Glycine and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 550xg for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells with 10 mL of ice cold PBS.
Resuspend cells in 5 mL of ice cold NIB (10 mM TrisHCl pH7.4, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM MgCl2, 0.1% igepal, 1x protease inhibitors).
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes with gentle mixing.
Aspirate media and wash cells with 10 mL of PBS at 37°C.
Add enough 0.25% Trypsin at 37°C to cover the monolayer.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes or until 90% of cells are no longer adhering to the surface.
Add media at a 1:1 ratio with trypsin to quench Trypsin.
Bring volume to 10 mL with media.
Resuspend cells in 10 mL of media, add 406 μL of 37% formaldehyde, and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes with gentle shaking.
Add 800 μL of 2.5 M Glycine and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 550xg for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells with 10 mL of ice cold PBS.
Resuspend cells in 5 mL of ice cold NIB.
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes with gentle mixing.
Place tissue sample in 2 mL dounce homogenizer on ice.
Add 2 mL of HEPES-NIB buffer to the sample and allow it to incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Dounce the sample 5 times with a loose pestle, followed by 15 strokes with a tight pestle.
Put the sample through a 35 μM cell strainer.
Bring the volume up to 10 mL with HEPES-NIB buffer.
Add 406 μL of 37% formaldehyde to the 10 mL solution.
Add 800 μL of 2.5 M Glycine and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Pellet cells or nuclei by spinning at 500 x g for 5 minutes.
Wash the pellet with 900 μL of 1x NEBuffer 2.1.
Resuspend the sample in 800 μL of 1x NEBuffer 2.1 with 12 μL of 20% SDS and incubate at 42°C with vigorous shaking for 30 minutes.
Add 5 μL of 5 mg/mL DAPI to the solution.
Pass through a 35 μm cell strainer.
Prepare tagmentation plate by adding 10 μL of 1x TD buffer (for one plate: mix 500 μL NIB buffer with 500 μL TD buffer).
Sort 2000 single nuclei into each well of the tagmentation plate.
Spin down the plate.
Add 1 μL of 2.5 μM uniquely indexed transposome to each well.
Seal the plate and incubate at 55°C for 15 minutes with gentle shaking.
Let the plate return to room temperature, then place on ice.
Pool all wells and add 5 μL of DAPI (5 mg/mL).
Pass the pooled mixture through a 35μM cell strainer.
Prepare a master mix for each well containing: 0.25 μL of 20mg/mL BSA, 0.5 μL of 1% SDS, and 7.75 μL H2O.
Add 8.5 μL of the prepared master mix and 2.5 μL of each (i5 and i7) 10 μM primer to each well of a 96 well plate.
Sort 15-22 single nuclei into each well using the most stringent sort settings.
Spin down the plate.
LAND ONLY: Incubate for 5 min at 55°C to denature transposase.
SDS ONLY: Incubate at 68°C for 45 minutes to denature transposase and reverse crosslinks.
Add 12 μL (7.5 μL NPM + 4 μL H2O + 0.5 μL 100x sybr green) to each well of a strip tube (for one plate: 750 μL NPM + 400 μL H2O + 50 μL sybr).
Perform the following PCR cycles: Heat to 72°C for 5 minutes.
Heat to 98°C for 30 seconds.
Continue with cycles of heating to 98°C for 10 seconds, then to 63°C for 30 seconds, followed by 72°C for one minute and a plate read. Add an additional 10 seconds at 72°C after each cycle.
Pool 5 μL from each well of the PCR plate.
Purify using Qiaquick PCR Purification column and elute in 30 μL of EB.
Run 2 μL of cleaned up pooled library on dsDNA HS qubit.
Use qubit reading to dilute library to ~4 ng/μL.
Run 1 μL on a High Sensitivity Bioanalyzer chip.
Use bioanalyzer concentration results for the range of 200 bp - 1 kb to dilute the pool to 1 nM for sequencing.
Set up NextSeq run as per manufacturers instructions for a 1 nM sample except for the following changes.
Load library pool at a concentration of 0.8 pM and a total volume of 1.5 mL into cartridge position 10.
Setup custom primers by diluting 9 μL of 100 μM stock sequencing primer 1 into a total of 1.5 mL of HT1 buffer into cartridge position 7.
Dilute 9 μL of 100 μM stock sequencing primer 2 into a total of 1.5 mL of HT1 buffer into cartridge position 8.
Dilute 18 μL of each custom index sequencing primer at 100 μM stock concentrations to a total of 3 mL of HT1 buffer into cartridge position 9.
Set NextSeq to operate in standalone mode.
Choose the SCIseq custom chemistry recipe \(Amini et. al. 2014).
Select dual index for the experiment.
Enter appropriate number of read cycles (50 recommended).
Enter 18 cycles for each index.
Select the custom checkbox for all reads and indices.
Process sequence data using the software included with this protocol according to the accompanying instructions.
